description: This file contains platform-specific functions for upgrading firmware, checking images, and handling different hardware boards within an embedded Linux environment. It includes upgrade procedures for various router and IoT devices, handling partition management, image extraction, and flashing commands.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the presence of specific partitions based on the board name and advises on partition deletion if needed.

methods.name: askey_do_upgrade
methods.description: Extracts the root filesystem from an upgrade tarball and writes it to flash, then initiates nand upgrade.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Extracts kernel and root filesystem images from a tarball and writes them to flash, with optional backup.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Prepares the kernel partition and performs a NAND upgrade for MikroTik devices.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that handles various device models and performs their specific upgrade procedures.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration data during upgrade, for certain models like glinet and google wifi.
